archetypes.name: auth-secrets
archetypes.rationale: diff adds Codex env-key auth where secret expansion and persistence risks need focused review
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the env-key auth path can expose the OPENAI_API_KEY value or persist larch-owned provider material in temp configs, sidecars, event logs, xtrace, or argv. Pay close attention to Bash expansion, eval-based array appends, set -x behavior, and differences between env unset, env empty, and env non-empty branches. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: launcher-parity
archetypes.rationale: the change wires one auth contract across several Codex launcher and direct-dispatch surfaces
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the Codex auth, trust, model-args, CODEX_HOME, and cleanup behavior across launch-codex-implement, launch-review, launch-codex-ci, check-reviewers, and review-and-fix. Look for missed call sites, inconsistent argv ordering, divergent fallback semantics, or documentation that overstates which direct codex exec lanes are covered. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: toml-stripper
archetypes.rationale: login fallback depends on a narrow custom TOML strip helper not corrupting user config
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the config-stripping helper for whether it removes only larch-owned openai-larch-env artifacts while preserving unrelated model providers, profiles, tables, comments, and multiline values. Check table-boundary handling, failure behavior, permissions assumptions, temporary-file handling, and whether bad rewrites can leave login fallback in a forced env-key state. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: probe-cache
archetypes.rationale: Codex health probing now has auth-mode-aware stamps and temp-home lifecycle logic
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Codex health-probe changes for cache semantics, auth retry behavior, and temp CODEX_HOME cleanup on success, failure, helper failure, and auth-retry returns. Verify that stale login-mode failures cannot suppress env-key probes while cached env-key failures are handled as intended without deriving from the secret value. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: fallback-observability
archetypes.rationale: review-and-fix now waterfalls Codex auth failures to Cursor and must remain diagnosable without leaking secrets
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the review-and-fix Codex branch for whether auth-helper failures and Codex dispatch failures are captured, redacted, and surfaced before Cursor fallback. Check that telemetry, wrapper logs, stderr tails, temporary homes, and return codes remain coherent when Codex setup fails early or exits nonzero. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
